messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: metering.delta.high — detected anomalous drop in emitted token counts (EU region). Overflagging rule fired and temporary overage flags created for ~320 accounts. Runbook: /runbooks/metering/delta.

maddy-oncall: I'm on it. taking page. any initial customer reports?

erin-cs: seeing 2 inbound support threads mentioning "unexpected overage" emails, queued in #support-escalations. will assemble list.

carla-billing: running quick windowed query to verify counts. posting query:

```sql
SELECT region, window_start, count(*) as tokens
FROM metering.events
WHERE window_start >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY region, window_start
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

carla-billing: results: EU windows around 2024-09-12T12:03-12:10 show ~38-45% deficit vs baseline; US looks normal.

ben-sre: checking streaming layer. kafka-consumer lag on topic metering-emitter-eu: consumer group metering-aggregator shows 2.3M lag starting at 169xxx (12:03). offsets jumped +2.4M then stalled.

dave-runtime: runtime telemetry shows emitter-proxy pods in eu1 experiencing kvcache evictions + file descriptor exhaustion at ~12:02. suspiciously coincident.

maddy-oncall: likely flow: emitter backlog -> missing events in aggregator -> counts drop -> fallback overflag triggered when downstream sees low counts? but that shouldn't create overage flags. we need to pause flagging and confirm.

carla-billing: agreed. immediate mitigations:
- pause "overage-detect-eu" rule (temporary)
- start targeted reingest for 12:00-12:12 windows
- kick off consumer group reset to advance processing safely if needed

maddy-oncall: execute pause now. carla, ben coordinate reingest. erin, CS standby for customer comms. dave, look at emitter-proxy pods.

deploy-bot: /actions/disable_rule overage-detect-eu accepted (job 8812). returning: queued -> running.

carla-billing: reingest job created: REINGEST-6001 (window 12:00-12:12). owner: carla-billing, ben-sre. estimate 25m to complete.

ben-sre: starting consumer group scrub and reassign. command run:
```bash
./kafka-tools/commit-offsets --group metering-aggregator --topic metering-emitter-eu --to-latest
```
Progress: reassigning partitions. monitoring lag and throughput.

dave-runtime: identified emitter-proxy pod eu-proxy-3 stuck in CrashLoop due to fd leak from new http client. restarting and scaling +1 to absorb burst. patching sidecar image to 1.4.2-rc with fd fix.

carla-billing: reingest progress: 0/12 windows processed (starting). will post heartbeat every 5m.

erin-cs: drafted customer note for affected accounts (subject: "Temporary metering anomaly, billing flags paused"). holding until we have final impacted list. will send targeted message and offer credits if overcharge occurs.

maddy-oncall: good. contingency if reingest doesn't recover counts: we keep overage flags paused and create manual reconciliation + credit plan. escalate to billing-ops after reingest if counts mismatch >1%.

ben-sre: consumer group reassign finished; lag decreasing. reingest job processing fragments now. first 3 windows show counts reconciling to baseline (~95-104%).

carla-billing: update: 8/12 windows reprocessed, residual deficit <0.7% aggregated. re-enable overage rule in monitoring-only mode (no auto-charges) for 10m to validate.

deploy-bot: /actions/enable_rule overage-detect-eu --mode monitor accepted (job 8818).

erin-cs: pulled list: 27 accounts received emails, 3 reported live requests. prepping outbound with apology + corrective note; will include timeline and credit plan.

maddy-oncall: summary for now: root cause candidate: emitter-proxy FD leak -> consumer stall -> delayed ingest -> transient low counts -> automated heuristic triggered overage flags. Mitigations: restarted + scaled emitter-proxy, reprocessed windows (REINGEST-6001), paused auto-charging rule, monitoring-only re-enable. Owners: carla-billing, ben-sre, dave-runtime, erin-cs.

carla-billing: created postmortem ticket BILLPOST-112 (link: /ops/BILLPOST-112) to document timeline, RCA, and credits.

dave-runtime: will follow up with a patch + canary of sidecar image and add FD metrics to alerting. plan to ship hotfix within 24h.

maddy-oncall: thanks all. update in 10 or sooner if customer impact increases.

erin-cs: sending targeted notes in 5 once reconfirm counts.

incident-bot: Status logged: incident_state=mitigated, severity=medium, owners=[carla-billing,ben-sre,dave-runtime,erin-cs].

erin-cs: final: reprocess complete, credits approved for affected 3 customers with visible overcharge. closing loop in support.

maddy-oncall: closing this thread — will convert to postmortem doc. great work.
